statement: A stale-only preflight snapshot refreshes the exact service_endpoints freshness evidence within its bounded wait, while topology, discovery, and replica-operation triggers retain their existing authoritative table scopes; the unchanged MovieLens live scenario maintains fresh schema-admission observations for the stability window and reports priority metric 0.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

A CACHE_STALE_WATERMARK-only preflight repair may refresh only the service_endpoints table whose mutation-or-authoritative-observation watermark the preflight freshness consumer measures; it must use the canonical complete-table read, receipt, reconcile, and observation-publication owner.

Any topology, discovery, cache-gap, or stale replica-operation trigger retains its existing authoritative repair table scope. In particular, combined cache-stale and stale-replica-operation repair remains the full nine-table repair; do not narrow evidence needed by another trigger.

Do not accept failed, partial, scoped, forged, or unreconciled authoritative reads as fresh; do not relabel observation as mutation, change the 5000ms stale threshold, or bypass complete-table receipt and getter-visible observation storage checks.

Before any live run, prove on current HEAD that a stale-only preflight selects the default nine-table scope and cannot return refreshed service_endpoints evidence within its bounded wait when unrelated reads are slow; red-on-revert the one-table policy correction and preserve compound-trigger scope tests.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.

The 2026-07-19T10:30:41.823Z report and archived raw run are the pre-fix witness: priority spread reached zero and four nine-table repairs completed in two groups about 7.5 seconds apart, but schema admission remained observation_unavailable/stale_usable with cache_stale_watermark.
